title: XpectraFlow
shortDescription: Telemetry and data infrastructure for mission-critical hardware.
description: XpectraFlow was built to make hardware testing and telemetry workflows faster and more reliable. I worked across the product and technical stack—from real-time ingestion and signal processing to APIs, visualization, data formats, and deployment.

title: ButterCut.ai
shortDescription: AI video editing for vernacular creators.
description: ButterCut.ai was an AI video editing product built for creators working in regional languages. I was CTO and co-founder, working across the product, engineering, and early-stage company building.

title: Shuttlecock Aerodynamics Research
shortDescription: Experimental research on the aerodynamics of rotating shuttlecocks.
description: My undergraduate thesis at IIT Kanpur focused on the aerodynamics of rotating shuttlecocks. I worked in Prof. Sanjay Mittal's lab and at the National Wind Tunnel Facility, working with experimental aerodynamics and wind-tunnel data.
